TargetSheet.apply accepts plan | plan[] and merges every named tab in ONE atomic write; apply(plan) behaves exactly as before.
A row is located by testing every entry of update.match when present, otherwise by key against the tab's key column.
A tab named in the plans but absent from the tracker is created; a tab absent from the plans is untouched.
The CLI merge build applies all tabs' plans in one apply call, so a stale Companies tab refreshes while a human-added column on it survives.

steps.scenario_name: every derived tab merges by its own key
steps.implementation_notes: Implements DR-0010 (every derived tab merges by its own key), whose Rules section is the contract. Widen ADDITIVELY: the 9 merge-plan and 13 target-sheet-apply scenarios pin today's single-tab shapes and must not change. Generalise the existing Jobs planner over a per-tab spec (key column(s), harvester columns) rather than copying it three times. Sources has no Dedup Key column at all, so apply must not demand one when matching by update.match — the NO_DEDUP_KEY_COLUMN probe refusal is correct for the Jobs tab only. Keep the in-place, cellNF:true write from 126418a so dates and formats survive on every tab. Counters (Jobs Seen, Messages, Jobs Found) come from the whole cache per DR-0009.
